# Recursive Enum defaults

An owned generic interface default retains `E extends Enum<E>`, `Class<E>`,
its distinct class formal and the unchanged erased runtime slot. A child
interface and generic receiver inherit that exact original body. The immutable
JVM harness owns its enum values outside the input DEX, checks direct,
interface, raw and reflected calls, 24 value combinations, 375 identities,
125 state observations and ten ordered failures. Raw mismatched enum arguments
retain the original accepted behavior. The source and unchanged declaration-JAR
profiles retain all generic metadata, original method ownership and zero bridges.
